entities.summary: La Ferrassie is an archaeological site in Savignac-de-Miremont, in the Dordogne department, France. The site, located in the Vézère valley, consists of a large and deep cave flanked by two rock shelters within a limestone cliff, under which there is a scree slope formation. La Ferrassie is a archaeological site from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
